_comment: Copy this to bed-map.json and fill in real device IPs, or use Admin → Connect a device (preferred). Bed identity always comes from this mapping, never from the device message — see src/bedMapping/bedMap.js. A plain bedId string uses the default adapter (BplVividVueM10, HL7). For any other model, use {bedId, deviceType}. The committed bed-map.json starts empty: hospital mappings are site data and must not be committed.
